name: 인하대학교 본캠퍼스
coordinates: metres; X east, Z south, Y up; local equirectangular projection
assumptions: OSM is community mapping, not a measured building survey.
Missing heights and all facade/window/roof details are visualization assumptions; do not use for surveying.
Tower/podium subdivisions of High-Tech and Anniversary Hall are photo-informed approximations inside the original footprint.
Trees are decorative placements; terrain is flat. Campus interiors are unavailable.
Official photos/maps are reference-only and not embedded.
